Class ChatLayout

java.lang.Object
dev.despical.pixelpainter.command.ChatLayout
public final class ChatLayout extends Object
Provides shared chat layout primitives for panel headings, hints and navigation.

Text is measured with Minecraft bitmap-font advances so centering depends on the rendered width instead of the character count. Formatting and interactions of the wrapped components are retained; only spacing is added. Console senders receive the plain text path of Messages.reply(CommandSender, Component).
